title: Oozy Fluffy Tunisian Lentils Wrap
description: A sour, fluffy Tunisian wrap filled with spiced lentils and creamy yogurt, wrapped in steamed spinach for a Mediterranean-friendly bite.
instructions: Rinse the puy lentils under cold water until the water runs clear.
In a medium saucepan, combine rinsed lentils and water; bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until lentils are tender but not mushy.
While the lentils cook, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion until translucent.
Add minced garlic, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, and harissa paste to the skillet; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir the sautéed spice mixture into the cooked lentils, then add lemon juice, salt, and pepper; let the mixture cool slightly.
Fold in Greek yogurt until the lentils become fluffy and slightly soupy.
Warm the spinach leaves in a steamer basket over boiling water for 30 seconds, then pat dry.
Spoon the fluffy lentil mixture onto each spinach leaf, spread evenly, and roll tightly into wraps.
Serve the wraps immediately while still warm, optionally garnished with chopped mint and parsley.
